Introduction
The compressed air produced by the ignition compressor is used to control the Pneumatic valve system for boiler ignition; the compressor raises the pressure from 6 bar to approximately 7.5 bar. There are 4 compressors in the station, operating in sequence automatically when the pressure drops, to secure the units, as there is a protection that trips the units when the pressure drops to approximately 3.1 bar. Each of these four compressors has its own tank and dryer; the four tanks are connected through tie valves, and there is also a valve connecting the air compressors and the ignition compressors to secure the units when the pressure drops.
The document was prepared by Eng. Ayman Mohamed Abdel Meguid, field-tested by Eng. Magdy Mahrous Shehata, with the approval of General Manager Eng. Abdel Azim Gomaa Hagras and the approval of Eng. Hussein Ahmed El-Mahdy, and certified by Eng. Gamal Abdel Wahab, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector and the company's MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
Issue the work order from the station Operations Department, signed by the instrument maintenance technicians assigned to carry out the maintenance work, under the supervision of the maintenance engineer executing the work order approved by the Head of the Instrument Maintenance Department.
Record the occupational safety and health category of all personnel working on the work order.
